title: The Number Falls
summary: On Day six, Maya and Dev follow the service elevator down to find who called it.

beats.text: Day six. The number fell all night. Forty. Thirty-nine. Thirty. Then it stopped.

beats.speaker: dev
beats.text: "Thirty is the skybridge," said Dev. "Ruth's way across."
A torch flashed from Calder Tower. Two long. Three short. Over and over.
I pinned the pattern on my city model. Two long, three short. Twenty-three.

beats.speaker: dev
beats.text: "That is not Ruth's code," said Dev. "Somebody is borrowing her torch."
At noon the elevator rang. Thirty. It was coming back up.
Dev took the keycards and braced his bad knee against the service door.
The doors opened on forty-one. A wet handprint marked the glass inside.

beats.speaker: ruth
beats.text: My phone buzzed. Ruth: "Do not take the elevator. It is not empty."
The car looked empty. Then its floor lamp slowly turned on.
